Finding: On UK AISI cyber ranges at a 100M-token budget, Claude Opus 5 solved "The Last Ones" enterprise network-attack simulation end-to-end in 8 of 10 attempts.
Finding Quote: On "The Last Ones," an enterprise network attack simulation, Opus 5 performed comparably to Mythos 5 and Mythos Preview. It solved the range end-to-end in 8/10 attempts.
Company Response: Anthropic reproduced UK AISI's cyber-range results verbatim in a titled section (3.3.6) of the Claude Opus 5 system card and escalated its cyber safeguards in response: §3.2 states that GIVEN Opus 5's stronger capabilities than Opus 4.8, cyber safeguards for the default user would resemble those applied to Claude Fable 5. The documented stack is a two-stage activation probe screening all traffic plus a trained LLM classifier, with classifier training data augmented by internal automated red-teamers and weighted toward longer-running agentic tasks — the same task class UK AISI's cyber ranges test. Binary vulnerability finding remains blocked (§3.4.1); the one loosening covers source-code vulnerability discovery only, on the defensive side, with Cyber Verification Program exemptions for verified defenders.
